name: ANTAR
tagline: An everyday super-app for Jakarta — ride, food, pay

brief.name: Antar
brief.industry: Indonesian everyday super-app — motorbike ride-hailing (ojek), food & grocery delivery, and a built-in e-wallet, serving Greater Jakarta and beyond
brief.audience: Urban Indonesians 18-40 on mid-range Android phones; busy commuters, students, warung owners, and the unbanked using the wallet for the first time. Bahasa Indonesia first.
brief.references: Gojek, Grab Indonesia, Tokopedia, Dana, ShopeePay; warung-economy energy
brief.context: Bahasa Indonesia copy ('Selamat datang', 'Pesan sekarang', 'Gratis ongkir'). Hero with the app value prop + dual app-store badges + a phone mockup. Service tiles (Ride, Food, Mart, Pay), a 'how it works' strip, driver/merchant earnings CTA, and a trust/footer band. Warm modern palette (Gojek-green energy or a batik-derived indigo); Javanese batik (parang/kawung) ONLY as a slim divider. Large friendly type, big touch targets for low-end devices.
brief.avoid: Full-bleed batik wallpaper. English-only. Tiny tap targets. Cold corporate fintech tone. Generic Western app-landing template with Indonesian words pasted in.
